description: The BCL-only IHtmlContentSanitizer (D12/D22), the default whenever the Engine package is not registered — i.e. the editor in Blazor WebAssembly. A tokenizer with HTML-encode, never a regex strip: every <, >, &, " and ' is encoded by default, only HtmlSanitizerPolicy allow-listed tags are re-emitted (without attributes, exception a[href] after the scheme check), unclosed elements are completed and orphan closing tags are encoded, so content can never inject </mj-text>, <mj-raw> or <!--. Unknown or invalid input degrades to escaped text, never to passthrough, and the output may only be stricter than the AngleSharp implementation.
